page.notes: Marginal notes read from the scan: "Lib. ix. de Asin.", "Olim in vsu.", "Asinar.", "Ferè in seruos.", "De Ira. iii cap. xxxii.", "Cap. lxvii", "Cap. xliiii.", "Interdum & liberos.", "Sen. de Ira iii cap. xviii.", "Polyb. i.", "Martyres sic occisi." Greek words in the paragraph are transcribed as best read; the Greek is doubtful in places. The word "adominata" and the note "Asinar." are as printed; the quotation "Crura herclè..." line is set apart as verse. Catchword "sæ-" is the hyphenated word at the foot of the last full line, not a separate catchword; the final word "uitum." is on a separate short line.
